fr_html: Au cours de la discussion sur cet article, on convient d'abord de faire de l'alinéa 4 un article séparé à insérer entre les articles 33 et 34 actuels. On convient ensuite que le mot „instruction”, dont se sert l'article 32, prête à interprétation.
en_html: During the discussion on this Article it was agreed first to make Paragraph 4 into a separate Article to be inserted between the present Articles 33 and 34. It was then agreed that the word “instruction” (preliminary proceedings), used in Article 32, is liable to misunderstanding.
